head: b5c5a0f2a46f35b55be951e54968ae35d84c846a plus custody changes
live_write_custody: auth_ingress only; API/observer read-only; DB maintenance, beat, relay and workers have no live-journal mount
custody_archive: signed immutable bundle per journal tip; deployment contract requires S3 Object Lock COMPLIANCE (>=365d), versioning and SSE-KMS; only custody/observer role writes
restore_guard: restore only into a missing live path or when the live chain is a prefix of the bundle; a newer live chain is left untouched; a divergent chain is refused
failure_scope: torn final line repaired before append without discarding committed lines
lost live volume recovered from a verified bundle
redeploy into an empty mount restores before new facts
stale bundle cannot overwrite newer committed history
limits: The S3 Object Lock bucket, EFS access points, IAM grants, backup policy and task mounts are deployment resources and were not provisioned or executed here.
This evidence does not claim that the financial-maintenance actor cannot reach the live volume unless the deployment topology and IAM are applied and audited.
